Mobile security, for example: security measures for smartphones and tablets, secure remote access and virtual private network (VPN).
Anti-malware software to protect against viruses, spyware, ransomware, et cetera, for example: Microsoft Security Essentials, Malwarebytes and Symantec Endpoint Protection.
Web security, for example: digital certificates and  website restrictions.
Email security, for example: spam filters and email scans.
Network security, for example: firewalls, proxy servers and honeypot systems.
Data protection and control, for example: encryption and rights management.
Point-Of-Sale (POS) security, for example: encryption of cardholder data.
Software and application security, for example: application whitelisting and scheduled patching.
Hardware and asset management, for example: inventory of information technology (IT) equipment and encrypted universal serial bus (USB) storage devices.
Identity and access management, for example: password complexity rules and  restrictions based on user accounts.
Physical access controls, for example: keypad access control systems and identity badges.
Multi-Factor Authentication, for example: biometric data authentication, one-time passwords, phone verification and security questions.
AI-based cyber security tools, for example: Microsoft Security Copilot, Darktrace, SentinelOne, Vectra AI, Cylance and Proofpoint.
